evidence.title: CIA officer arrested with gold bars admits he exposed secret intelligence source to a foreign official

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal search inventory and seizure records
occurrences.quote_span: ALEXANDRIA, Virginia — A high-ranking CIA officer arrested after federal agents found roughly 600 pounds of gold bars stashed in his home also disclosed details about a secret U.S. intelligence source to a foreign official, prosecutors said Tuesday during his plea hearing.
occurrences.speaker: Federal prosecutors
occurrences.subject: David Rush

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal search warrant inventory and seizure records
occurrences.quote_span: During their search of his home, investigators seized about 300 gold bars, federal officials said, along with about $2 million in U.S. currency and 35 luxury watches.
occurrences.speaker: Federal officials
occurrences.subject: David Rush

occurrences.quote_span: Rush has been in jail since his arrest May 19, after investigators said he made up details about his education and military service record, fooling the nation’s top spy agency for years.
